chunks: Those who deny and transgress will not be forgiven by God, nor be shown the way
ai.seo_question: Who will not be forgiven or guided by God according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine justice where persistent disbelief coupled with self-harm (dhulm) creates a spiritual barrier, preventing both forgiveness and guidance. It reflects the principle that God’s mercy is contingent upon sincere repentance, and those who harden their hearts against truth forfeit the path to clarity. This serves as a warning against the cumulative effect of denying divine signs while actively committing sins.
